common.tagline: Connected healthcare for East, Adamawa and North Cameroon.

home.title: Welcome to JoRapha
home.intro: Patients, clinicians, facilities and community health workers, together on one platform.

patient.title: Patient area
patient.description: Book appointments, view your record and your results.
patient.imageAlt: A clinician in consultation with a patient

clinician.title: Clinician area
clinician.description: Manage availability, consult, document and refer.

facility.title: Facility area
facility.description: Manage your facility's profile, staff and services.
facility.imageAlt: Hospital room ready for a patient

admin.title: Admin console
admin.description: Configure the platform, users and policies.

patient.title: Hello!
patient.body: Welcome to the JoRapha patient app. Care for you and your family, even offline.
patient.imageAlt: A smiling nurse with a mother and her newborn

chw.title: Hello, health worker!
chw.body: Welcome to the JoRapha community health worker app. Record your visits, even without a network.
chw.imageAlt: A clinician on a home visit with a tablet

reason.NOT_FOUND: Record not found on the server
reason.STALE_VERSION: Changed elsewhere in the meantime: needs review
reason.FORBIDDEN: Account not allowed: contact your supervisor

sync.pendingNotice: {{count}} record(s) pending: not yet received by the server.
sync.failing: Sync is failing: nothing is being sent or received. Your records stay on this phone, marked pending, and will be sent once sync works again.

signIn.title: Health worker sign-in
signIn.error: Could not sign in. Check your details and the network.
signIn.firstSignInNeedsNetwork: The first sign-in needs a network connection.

households.title: Households
households.name: Name or head of household
households.noCatchment: No catchment is assigned to your account.
households.invalid: Enter at least the name and the number of members (0 to 100).
households.pendingSignOut: {{count}} record(s) not sent yet. Connect to the network and wait for sync before signing out.
households.catchmentNotSynced: Your catchment has not downloaded yet. Connect to the network and wait for the first sync before adding households.

metrics.title: Spike measurements
metrics.coldStartNotMeasured: Start-up to list: not measured (signed in during this run)

chw.deviceRevoked: This device has been revoked. Local data has been erased.
chw.encryptionMissing: Local encryption is not active: the app refuses to start.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.staffIntro: Clinicians, facility and platform staff: e-mail and password, then your authenticator app.
signIn.patientIntro: Sign in with a code sent to your phone, or a link sent to your e-mail.
signIn.codeSent: If this number can receive SMS, a 6-digit code is on its way.
signIn.linkSent: If this address can receive e-mail, a sign-in link is on its way. It works once.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.enrollIntro: Health staff accounts are protected by an authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator or Aegis).
mfa.scanQr: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.secretLabel: Cannot scan? Enter this key instead:
mfa.challengeIntro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

recover.title: Reset your password
recover.intro: Enter the e-mail address of your account. We will send a link to choose a new password.
recover.sent: If an account uses this address, a reset link is on its way.

account.title: My account
account.devicesIntro: Phones and tablets registered with your account. Revoking one stops its sync and erases its local data at its next connection.
account.signOutEverywhereHint: Ends your sessions on every browser and device, including this one.

noAccess.title: No access
noAccess.body: Your account does not have access to this area. If you think it should, contact your administrator.

errors.invalidPhone: Enter a Cameroon number: 9 digits starting with 6 or 2.
errors.invalidCode: This code is not valid or has expired.
errors.tryAgain: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
errors.passwordLength: The password must have between 12 and 200 characters.
errors.linkInvalid: This link is not valid or has already been used. Please ask for a new one.
